verified_claims: Scope 1 covers emissions from operations owned or controlled by the reporting company, including stationary combustion such as boilers.
Scope 2 covers generation of purchased or acquired electricity, steam, heating, or cooling consumed by the reporting company.
Scope 3 covers other indirect upstream and downstream value-chain emissions not included in scope 2.
The FAQ defers authoritative interpretation to the relevant GHG Protocol standards.
The 2030 Agenda contains 17 Sustainable Development Goals and 169 targets.
The goals are integrated and indivisible across social, economic, and environmental dimensions.
Goal 13 concerns climate action and Goal 15 concerns terrestrial ecosystems and forests.
KOFPI describes the forest carbon offset program as voluntary carbon-sink maintenance and enhancement activities whose additional removals are government-certified.
The public procedure separates project planning, review and registration, implementation and monitoring, verification, certification, and transaction or promotion stages.
The forest carbon registry is described as a system managing removals obtained through forest carbon offset projects.
